extra_inputs.name: cc-1.5.1.crate
extra_inputs.reason: scripts.d/50-rav1e.sh runs `cargo update cc` at build time, which moves the lockfile's cc 1.2.26 to the newest compatible 1.x on crates.io. The newest 1.x published before the job started (2026-09-26T12:29:47Z) is 1.5.1 (published 2026-09-25T13:33Z). cc is a build-script helper and is not linked into ffmpeg.exe; included for completeness. `cargo update cc` can also refresh cc's own small dependencies (jobserver, shlex, find-msvc-tools); those are build-time only as well.

known_gaps: Compilers are identified from strings embedded in the binary rather than from a pinned image: BtbN's images install Ubuntu 26.04 packages, `rustup` stable and a crosstool-NG clone at image-build time. The binary itself names GCC 16.2.0 built by crosstool-NG 1.29.0.7_b1a94f6 and rustc commit 48a229ceaefd (Rust 1.98.1); those sources are included under toolchain/.

General-purpose build tools (Ubuntu packages, cmake, meson, nasm, cargo-c, binutils, the compiler's own host libraries gmp/mpfr/mpc/isl) are not part of the linked work and are not included by default (GPLv3 section 1 excludes general-purpose tools used unmodified). binutils 2.47 can be added with --with-optional-toolchain.

BtbN's CI reuses Docker layer caches (cache-from). A stage layer is only reused when its Dockerfile instruction and mounted stage script/download cache are unchanged, so a cached layer was built from the same pinned source recorded here.

`.git` metadata is removed from every fetched tree so the archive is byte-reproducible; each stage archive's SOURCE-REVISIONS.scoutmind.txt keeps the commit and remote of every repository. Some projects derive cosmetic version strings from git metadata at build time (for example x264's build number).

rav1e: `cargo update cc` re-resolved the cc build dependency at build time (see extra_inputs: best determination cc 1.5.1). All crates linked into ffmpeg.exe come from rav1e's committed Cargo.lock, which the archive vendors with checksum verification.
Only bin/ffmpeg.exe is redistributed by ScoutMind (ffprobe.exe and ffplay.exe from the same zip are not shipped); the same sources cover all three.
